decisive_spans.text: a 1.09 × 0.79 cm well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow

response.rationale: The presence of a well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion with internal blood flow strongly supports testicular cancer (D6) and testicular tumor (D1). The elevated CA19-9 further supports D6. Testicular torsion (D3) is contradicted by the lack of acute symptoms and the ultrasound findings.
